outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image only, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B contains phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot.

Top shows flow cytometry density/scatter plots (raw single-cell data, exempt from needing overlay points). Bottom bar chart (mean ± SEM) has individual data points overlaid as distinct markers (circles, squares, triangles, inverted triangles) for each replicate.
Top shows flow cytometry density/scatter plots (raw data, exempt). Bottom bar chart (mean ± SD) shows individual data points overlaid as markers for each of the n=3 replicates.
Panel E is a heatmap of Z-scores; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel F is a western blot image only, not a plot of averaged data.
Both bar charts (mean ± SEM, n=3) display individual data points overlaid as distinct markers (circles, squares, triangles) for each gene/condition.
Panel H contains immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
